messages:
Elena: Morning all — quick heads-up about tomorrow's hybrid all-hands (9:30am PT). Short agenda below, pls drop any Qs into this thread or the doc linked. We'll record and share clips. High-level agenda:
1) Product: Dedicated rollout + SLOs (Marcus)
2) Reliability: incident playbook updates + on-call flow (Ravi)
3) People: parental leave policy update + Q&A (Jenna)
4) GTM: enterprise partnerships & pilot customers (Priya)
5) AMA (execs)
6) Closing: takeaways & action owners

Logistics: onsite in SF HQ front conference; remote join link: https://zoom.redwood.example/ah. Onsite catering will be provided — add dietary needs in the form here: https://forms.redwood.example/dietary. Recording will be posted within 24h and short clips for exec highlights within 48h.

Quick asks: please prefix questions with [Q] and the agenda item number, submit any hard or policy questions by EOD today so we can prep answers. If you'd rather discuss privately, DM me or book with Jenna. — E

Marcus: I'll run a 5-minute demo and a rollout timeline. Planning to call out latency and cost targets for Dedicated — any specific metrics folks want highlighted?

Ravi: We'll cover proposed changes to the postmortem cadence and the new escalation steps. Playbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.example/playbooks/oncall. Note: new fallback routing policy goes live Monday — will summarize the rollout plan and mitigation windows during my section.

Jenna: HR update — parental leave policy extended to 18 weeks for primary caregivers, with flexible phased return options. Full policy doc: https://hr.redwood.example/leave. We'll run a 15-min Q&A during the meeting and hold drop-in office hours this week. If you need private support, book via People Ops calendar.

Priya: I'll share a short customer snapshot on the enterprise pilot and ask for feedback on the migration assistance package.

Elena: Friendly reminder — submit any pressing questions by 5pm today. If you're adding a question here, tag which agenda item it maps to (e.g., [Q][2] "escalation thresholds").

Ravi: [Q][2] Will the escalation thresholds change for P1 incidents or just the notification flow? Short answer: thresholds stay the same for now; we'll change notification routing and add a secondary on-call tier. Full details in the talk.

Marcus: [Q][1] For Dedicated rollout: will we offer migration engineering hours to pilot customers? Yes — we'll outline a partner migration program (50 hours included for early adopters).

Priya: Adding customer-facing asks into the doc now.

Jenna: Catering note — vegetarian and gluten-free options confirmed. If you have allergies, fill the form asap.

ops-bot: Recording/clip bot: Recording will be uploaded to the all-hands page and this channel within 24h, transcript attached. If you want a private clip flagged for your team, react with :clapper: and ops will queue it.

Elena: Thanks — appreciate the quick sync. If you have an item to add to the agenda, drop it here before EOD. See you tomorrow.

Marcus: 👍

Ravi: 👍

Priya: Thanks — adding a couple slides for the pilot customer feedback.
